# Spleen 6×12

The Pi reference application uses the upstream Spleen 6×12 BDF bitmap font,
version 2.2.0, by Frederic Cambus. The source and BSD 2-Clause license were
retrieved from https://github.com/fcambus/spleen on 2026-09-27.

The source SHA-256 is
`fc0743d164690f99b7e2e1b9d503180e4c719a9831ae03fd8f6da18c857dee27`.
The license SHA-256 is
`f33fe8679d5b2abecc4f1313ce6c6bfa58262964de5f7bca146596a7318047af`.
The Pi generator validates both before selecting the SPEC-001 glyph subset.
